decisions.reason: A full ESP32 pin breakout and generic-platform reuse can remain on a single integrated board, and the source does not change its pin coverage, placement, connector style, or pitch.

This task-local requirement concerns the manufacturing BOM for the legacy main-board artifact. Starting a new integrated-board design does not retroactively change that artifact's connector-population decision or BOM readiness.

The single-board architecture makes the activation phrase 'without the power board' obsolete, but the source does not specify the replacement USB/AXP2101 source-selection and Schottky-OR behavior. Safely propagating a new electrical rule requires a client design decision.

The existing message-750 MODIFY already moves the pull-ups to the integrated board, removes the obsolete interboard-cable-length attribute, and updates the scope while leaving the still-valid electrical conditioning rules intact.
